## 3. EA Sports FC 27 Ultimate Team 5% Transfer Tax Formula
- EA collects a flat 5% tax on all Transfer Market sales (`netPerCard = sellCoins - round(sellCoins * 0.05)`).
- Exact break-even sell price: `ceil(buyCoins / 0.95)`.
| Buy Price | Minimum Break-Even Sell | Profit Example (+15% Sale) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 100,000 | 105,264 (snap 106,000) | +9,250 at 115,000 sell |
| 250,000 | 263,158 (snap 264,000) | +23,125 at 287,500 sell |
| 500,000 | 526,316 (snap 527,000) | +46,250 at 575,000 sell |
| 1,000,000 | 1,052,632 (snap 1,053,000) | +92,500 at 1,150,000 sell |

## 4. Minecraft Nether Portal 8:1 Coordinate Conversion
- Overworld X and Z divide by 8 (floored) for Nether X and Z; Y height stays matched on the vertical axis for safe linking.
| Overworld (X, Y, Z) | Nether Target (X, Y, Z) | Overworld Chunk |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (0, 64, 0) | (0, 64, 0) | Chunk (0, 0) |
| (-200, 64, 400) | (-25, 64, 50) | Chunk (-13, 25) |
| (1200, 64, -800) | (150, 64, -100) | Chunk (75, -50) |
| (-4000, 70, 2400) | (-500, 70, 300) | Chunk (-250, 150) |

| 1 | $1,900 |

| 3 | $2,900 |
| 4 | $3,400 |

## 7. Fortnite Level 200 Pace & Apex Free Pack Totals
- Battle Pass math uses 80,000 XP per level. From level 44 to 200 with 28 days remaining requires 5.6 levels/day (445,715 XP/day).
- Apex Legends Levels 1–500 award 199 total free Apex Packs (out of 500 needed for Heirloom Shards pity).

## 8. GTA Online Cayo Perico Payout Math
- Support crew / Pavel (2%) + fencing fee (10%) deduct 12% combined on Hard Mode. Example $1.3M primary + $450k secondary at 50/50 leaves net pool $1,654,400 ($827,200 host share before $100k setup fee).
